mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 110 (index 2017=100) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market that enhances consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate sustained consumer demand for housing, which supports economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST rises > 0.5% in a late-cycle expansion regime over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level above 360,000 million dollars indicates robust consumer spending, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 360000 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a broadening of economic growth beyond the housing sector, which supports diversified corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases and HOUST declines over any 3-year rolling window.
